@graph.dc:title: IRLCG portable participation ontology
@graph.dcterms:description: Portable real-world participation mechanics shared by Linked applications. Application scoring, policy, user interfaces, and domain-specific records are intentionally excluded.

@graph.rdfs:label: Team
@graph.rdfs:comment: A group of people coordinating real-world participation.

@graph.rdfs:label: Participation action
@graph.rdfs:comment: An action definition or activity that can be referenced by a real-world participation experience.

@graph.rdfs:label: Action plan
@graph.rdfs:comment: A participant's plan or intention to carry out a participation action.

@graph.rdfs:label: Participation event
@graph.rdfs:comment: A scheduled real-world or hybrid occasion in which participation occurs.

@graph.rdfs:label: Mission
@graph.rdfs:comment: A reusable goal or commitment whose completion criteria are evaluated from linked participation facts.

@graph.rdfs:label: Participation opportunity
@graph.rdfs:comment: A public call for people to participate, optionally before a specific event exists.

@graph.rdfs:label: Participation commitment
@graph.rdfs:comment: A person's response or commitment to participate in an event or mission.

@graph.rdfs:label: Check in
@graph.rdfs:comment: A raw observation that a person arrived for participation; it does not by itself credit time or impact.

@graph.rdfs:label: Check out
@graph.rdfs:comment: A raw observation that a person departed from participation; it does not by itself credit time or impact.

@graph.rdfs:label: Participation invitation
@graph.rdfs:comment: An invitation to participate. Recognition or attribution derived from it is governed elsewhere.

@graph.rdfs:label: Alliance
@graph.rdfs:comment: A consensual reified relationship between people participating as allies.

@graph.rdfs:label: Mentorship
@graph.rdfs:comment: A consensual directional relationship in which one participant mentors another.
